cs.t: This is awesome. I'm going to have to spend some time digging over this. I got one of these GB10s, but the ASUS variety. So far fairly happy with it.  Most days I don't remember I'm on ARM. It's pretty performant, snappy, about the same speed as my other mini PC, a Ryzen 9 7940HS Minisforum UM 790 Pro, but with double the amount of cores and many times the amount of RAM.
